name: Coros
short_desc: External: connect COROS so Health and your agent get sleep, HRV, resting heart rate and training load (read-only). Just sign in with your COROS account.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your COROS with one button inside the app. What you need: only your free COROS account (the one your watch syncs to). You sign in on COROS's own page; there is no developer account, approval, key or fee, because the app uses COROS's self-service MCP connection for apps. The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows sleep score and stages, HRV, resting heart rate and COROS training load. COROS has no daily recovery score, so this source sends none.
